title: Pure Raidraptor
summary: Pure Raidraptor Xyz combo deck, deploying Level 4 DARK Winged Beast monsters that swarm the field and climb into formidable avian bosses with Rank-Up-Magic spells. The modern support engine centers on Raidraptor - Noir Lanius and Raidraptor - Bloom Vulture, enabling rapid searches and multi-monster revivals that easily construct Rank 13 Raidraptor - Rising Rebellion Falcon.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Raidraptor - Noir Lanius: Premier starter that searches a Raidraptor monster with a different Level and modulates field Levels from the GY.
Raidraptor - Bloom Vulture: Special Summons itself along with another Raidraptor from hand, or revives two Raidraptors from GY onto an empty field.
Raidraptor - Tribute Lanius: Normal Summon engine that mills Mimicry Lanius or searches a Rank-Up-Magic Quick-Play Spell when destroying monsters.
Raidraptor - Mimicry Lanius: Banishes itself from GY on the turn it is sent to search any Raidraptor card, including Spells and Traps.
Raidraptor - Roost: Continuous Spell searching a Raidraptor Spell or Trap whenever an archetype monster is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Normal Summon Raidraptor - Noir Lanius and activate its effect to search Raidraptor - Bloom Vulture from your Deck.
Special Summon Raidraptor - Bloom Vulture and Special Summon an additional Raidraptor (such as Raidraptor - Strangle Lanius or Raider's Wing) from hand.
Overlay two Level 4 monsters into Raidraptor - Force Strix and detach to search Raidraptor - Singing Lanius.
Link Summon Raidraptor - Wise Strix using Force Strix and a remaining monster, summoning a Level 4 Winged Beast from Deck.
Trigger Force Strix to activate Wise Strix, Setting a Rank-Up-Magic Spell directly from the Deck.
Xyz Summon Rank 5 Raidraptor - Brave Strix to Set Rise Rank-Up-Magic Raidraptor's Force or Raidraptor - Glorious Bright.
Pass turn with Rise Rank-Up-Magic ready to combine your Xyz Monsters into Rank 13 Raidraptor - Rising Rebellion Falcon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Raidraptor - Rising Rebellion Falcon: Rank 13 behemoth unaffected by other cards' effects that wipes the opponent's entire field and burns for damage.
Raidraptor - Ultimate Falcon: Unaffected Rank 10 boss that detaches material to reduce opponent's ATK and prevent card activations for the turn.
Raidraptor - Brave Strix: Rank 5 playmaker that sets archetype Spells and Traps directly from Deck.
Raidraptor - Wise Strix & Raidraptor - Force Strix: Core link and rank-4 engines that tutor monsters and set Rank-Up-Magic spells from Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Rise Rank-Up-Magic Raidraptor's Force: Quick-Play Spell combining two Raidraptor Xyz Monsters into a single boss whose Rank equals their combined Ranks.
Raidraptor - Glorious Bright: Searchable Normal Trap that negates any face-up card and recycles a Raidraptor monster from GY.
Raidraptor's Phantom Knights Claw: Counter Trap detaching an Xyz material to negate and destroy an opposing monster effect while buffing your Xyz.
Raidraptor - Roost & Raidraptor - Nest: Sustained resource engines recycling and searching Raidraptor cards every turn.
